Kwame, I can't post that rate in #coastal-team yet, and I can't find it in what I can see. I searched this conversation and found no Driftmoor per-seat figure from you.

If you want this to go ahead, you can:
- Send Bettina the rate directly yourself, or
- Ask June or Anselm to confirm it can go into #coastal-team for the pipeline sheet. I can send that request for you once you tell me the figure and confirm that's the one you want posted.
